cases.observed:
(a) cmd: python3.12 -c '...DecisionRecordV1.from_mapping(data)...' on the withdrawn DB-03 record (expires_at 2026-08-20T00:00:00Z): bare from_mapping() -> ACCEPTED, decision_id=DB-03, outcome=GO; from_mapping(now=datetime(2027,1,1,tzinfo=utc)) -> raised InvalidContractValue: 'decision is expired'. Confirms README's expiry-gate claim: default now=None skips the gate, an explicit future now triggers it, exactly as worded.
(b) script built two full valid decision sets against src/wiki_spike/memory_core/second_brain_contracts.py using throwaway in-memory Ed25519 keys (never touches ~/keys/wiki-spike-local/*.pem): scenario 1 omits one required DB-02 expected-scope entry (all scopes otherwise present, no global NO_GO) -> resolve_second_brain_contract raised InvalidContractValue: 'decision evidence does not exactly match the expected-scope manifest' (did NOT return BLOCKED); scenario 2 keeps every scope entry intact and only flips global decision DB-01 to NO_GO -> resolve_second_brain_contract returned outcome=BLOCKED, blocked_decisions=['DB-01']. Confirms README's claim: InvalidContractValue for expected-scope-manifest mismatch, BLOCKED reserved for global-scope NO_GO. Both README claims verified true; no blocker.
